events.body:
## Context

BLT-Design-Contest (`blt-design-contest/`) is rated **Silver** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-design-contest): it meets 93% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-design-contest` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-design-contest
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-design-contest
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
